0.name: TEXT_REGLAKMASTERGATHERER_00161_TATAROGA_000_000
0.description: I'm a personal assistant of Master Wiscard hisself. Who're you? You don't know the big man? Then, all the 'stounding wares I have─you don't know these either. Farewell!
0.translation_description: Sono l'assistente personale del maestro Wiscard in persona. Tu chi sei? Non conosci il pezzo grosso? E allora non conosci nemmeno la mia merce incredibile─addio!

1.name: TEXT_REGLAKMASTERGATHERER_00161_TATAROGA_000_010
1.description: You know Master Wiscard? Why didn't you say so!? Come on in, you'll find something in here for you!
1.translation_description: Conosci il maestro Wiscard? Perché non l'hai detto subito!? Entra pure, vedrai che qui c'è qualcosa per te!
